definitions.gloss: everyday use; (of an item) suitable for daily use rather than special occasions
definitions.explanation: Refers to items — clothing, dishes, accessories, bags, etc. — that are intended or appropriate for ordinary daily use, as opposed to being kept for special occasions. Often paired with の as a noun modifier: {普段使|ふだんづか}いの〜.

examples.japanese: {普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧です。
examples.english: It's a bag for everyday use.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: These dishes are well-suited for everyday use.

examples.japanese: {普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for an everyday watch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧すぎる。
examples.english: The kimono I got from my grandmother is too flashy for everyday wear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧な⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}って→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧{普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、かえって⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some say that even expensive bags actually last longer if you bite the bullet and use them every day.

notes:
{普段使|ふだんづか}い combines ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧ (ordinary, usual) with ⟦{使|つか}い→使い：25633_tsukai⟧ (use, the noun form of ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧). Note the rendaku — つかい becomes づかい in compound. The term refers to items intended for everyday use rather than for special occasions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧ / ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧ / ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧: everyday bag / wallet / watch
- {普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧: everyday tableware
- {普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: to be suited for everyday use
- {普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: can be used everyday
- {普段使|ふだんづか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧すぎる: too flashy for everyday use

USAGE:
- The term carries an implicit contrast: items kept for ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な{時|とき} (special occasions) vs. items used regularly. Many Japanese households traditionally distinguish "good" tableware/clothing from {普段使|ふだんづか}い versions.
- Frequently appears in lifestyle articles, product copy, and online shopping listings for accessories, bags, and home goods.

SIMILAR PHRASES:
- {日常使|にちじょうづか}い: daily use (similar meaning, slightly more formal)
- ⟦{普段着|ふだんぎ}→普段着：15346_fudangi⟧: everyday clothes (specifically clothing)
- {よそ行|よそゆ}き: "going out" / dressy clothes (the contrastive concept)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧: usually, ordinarily
- ⟦{使|つか}い{道|みち}→使い道：07798_tsukaimichi⟧: use, application
